translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Yonatani ipilasi Debida

E oluvi Debida isakaula metoya Naioti mapilana Rama, e ilokaiaga Yonatani. E ikatupoi Yonatani kawala, “Avai vavagi bogwa lavagi ke? Ki, kaina sita pikolela wowogu isisu? Ammakawala layogagi tamam paila uula magila bikatumataigu?”

E Yonatani ivitakauloki kawala, “Galaga ibodi Yaubada nanola bukukwaliga! Ka, komwaidona vavagi avaka tamagu bivagi, kaina vavagi mwau kaina gala, tuta komwaidona ilukwaigu wala, e mauula gala bikikiwoli makwaina vavagi metoya baisa yeigu. M biga baisa sopawokuva wala.”

Mitaga Debida ivitakauloki kawala, “E tamam saina wala inikoli ammakawala lokuvigakaigu tombwailim yeigu, e kaina bogwa inanamsa mwada gala bitugwali bukunikoli avaka eininamsi bivagi, paila yoku wala bukulumkoli mmayuyu. Akatotila baisa yoku omatala Guyau Tomomova kidamwa yeigu asisu wala olopola kaliga!”
E Yonatani ikaibiga, kawala, “Avaka avaka magim bogwa bavagi wala.”
E Debida ivitakauloki kawala, “Ka, nabwaia Navau Tubukona Pakala,
e yeigu ibodi wala bakakam deli guyau. Mitaga kidamwa yoku kudoki bwaina wala, e yeigu bala basipepuni osaivau wa bagula, e basisu wala bila nabwaia ikoyavi.

Kidamwa tamam bivitoki tolosila yeigu gala deli okabokamkwam, e kuluki kawam, ‘Bogwa ikugwa inigadaigu binanakwa bilokaia veyala mapilana Bedeliem, paila tuta makwaina ikaloubusi paila veyala komwaidona bigabwaisi lula.’
E kidamwa tamam bilivala, ‘E bwaina wala,’ e ibodi wala bakwala. Mitaga kidamwa bigibuluwa, bukunikoli wala matauna bogwa ininatotila paila biyogagaigu.

Akoma lopom bukuvagi makwaina nanamsa, deli bukuwotitali m biga katotila kwebumaboma bogwa lokuvagi baisa yeigu. E kidamwa isim pikolela wowogu, anigadaim titoulem wala bukukwatumataigu! Ki, avaka kala bwaina kidamwa bukuuyokaigu tamam e matauna bikatumataigu?”
E Yonatani ivitakauloki kawala, “Wo! Gala ibodaim bukunanamsa makawala! Kidamwa banikoli mokwita mwada tamagu bogwa ininatotila paila biyogagaim, e bogwa balukwaim bukunikoli.”
E Debida ikatupoi kawala, “Availaga bilukwaigu banikoli kidamwa tamam bivitakaulokaim deli wala la gibuluwa?
E Yonatani ikaibiga kawala, “Tam osaivau.” E mapaila ilosi.

Yonatani iluki Debida kawala, “Ibodi Guyau matauna mina Isireli si Yaubada bivigaki da tosola! Makawala tuta nabwaia deli bugiyu yeigu bakatupoi tamagu. Kidamwa nanola bimanum baisa yoku, e yeigu bawitali biga baisa yoku.

Kidamwaga nanola mwada biyogagaim, yeigu balukwaim e bapilasaim bukula ambaisa bukubwaina. Ibodi wala Guyau bikatumataigu kidamwa gala bavagi makawala! Ibodi Guyau bisikailim makawala goli matauna eisikaili tamagu!
E kidamwa yeigu basisu tomomova, akoma lopom, kuvagi makawala m biga katotila kwaibumaboma, e bukukimidagi baisa yeigu. Mitaga kidamwa bakaliga,
kuvigaki makawala wala kimidagila baisa veyagwa tuta gala biwokuva. E avai tuta Guyau bikatumtuwoli komwaidona kam tilaula,
ibodi wala da biga katotila makwaina gala bitotina. Ka, kidamwa bitotina e Guyau bogwa bimipukwaim.”
E sivatala tuvaila Yonatani iluki Debida mwada bikatotila biyebwaili matauna, paila Yonatani iyebwaili Debida makawala goli iyebwaili titoulela.
Yonatani ikaibiga baisa matauna kawala, “Igau nabwaia Navau Tubukona Pakala, e kidamwa yoku bukusiwa e bogwa bivitokaisi tolosila baisa okabokamkwam.
E kaina igau bugiyu bukusiwa e tuvaila goli gala bigisaimsi, bogwa bininayuwasi. Mapaila bukula om kabosipepuni liloubogwa, e baisa bukusipepuni opapala magulona dakuna.
E igau balavi kaitolu kaiyala biwokaiamsi, e mwada bayamwasi magulona dakuna.

Oluvi baluki matauna ulo touwata biwa binainevi makaisina kaiyala. E kidamwa baluki matauna kawagu, ‘Mwa! Kaiyala makaisina baisa emaima otalim, kukwau makaisinʹo,’ e baisa kala katumiki yoku tobwaila wala, e bukusunapula bukuma. Yeigu bogwa akatotila baisa omatala Guyau Tomomova mwada yoku gala bukusilagi.
Mitaga kidamwa baluki matauna kawagu, ‘Mwa! Kaiyala makaisina ewaiwʹe baisa omatam!’ - e yoku bukusilavi baisa. Paila uula Guyau bogwa eiwitalaim bukula ambaisa.
E makwaina da biga katotila bogwa leitavagi kadataiyu, makawala goli Guyau bogwa biyamati kidamwa bitayosivagasi makawala, tuta gala biwokuva.”
Mapaila Debida ila isipepuni osaivau. E otutala Navau Tubukona Pakala, guyau Saulo ima okamkwam makwaina,
e isili okabala katitaikinela otaboda. E Abina isili opapala matauna, e Yonatani isivilaki Saulo. Debida kabala kwaiwokuva wala,
mitaga Saulo gala avaka ilivala yam makwaina. Paila uula idoki, “Kwaitala vavagi bogwa eikaloubusi baisa matauna, e mapaila eiyogwali titoulela.”
E bogwa leiwokuva Tubukona Navau Pakala, eiyamgwa Debida kabala isisu kwaiwokuva wala. E Saulo ikatupoi Yonatani kawala, “Avaka paila Debida gala ima otutala kamkwam lova deli lagaila?”
E Yonatani ivitakauloki tamala kawala, “Matauna bogwa ikugwa inigadaigu kidamwa batugwali matauna bila Bedeliem.

Ikaibiga, kawala, ‘Mwa! Akoma lopom, kutagwala bala, paila veyagwa bipakasi lula pakala oma valusi, e tuwagu eikaraiwogaigu balokaia baisa. Mapaila kidamwa yoku lubaigu mokwita, bwaina bukutugwalaigu bala agisi dalegu.’ Baisa uula matauna kabala ikwaiwokuva om kwabokamkwam.”

E Saulo igidaleiya baisa Yonatani e iluki matauna kawala, “Yoku mokwita wala inam isikubukubuyaim. Ka, tuta baisa bogwa lanikoli kami livala kwaitala wala som Debida. Lokuyomsilaimi kamitaiyu som inam!
Ki, gala kunikoli kidamwa Debida isisu tomomova, yoku gala avai tuta bukuguyoi valu makwaina? Ka, baisa tuta bukulokaia matauna bukumiakaigu baisa - matauna ibodi bikaliga.”
E Yonatani ivitakauloki kawala, “Avaka paila bikaliga? Ki, avai sula eivagi?”
Mapaila Saulo ilavi la kaiyala ilokaia Yonatani mwada bikatumati matauna, e Yonatani ivitusi kidamwa tamala bogwa eininatotila bikatumati Debida.

Mapaila Yonatani itokaia metoya okabokamkwam deli kala leiya isunapula, e yam makwaina kwemwaidona gala wala sitana avaka ikoma - baisa kwaiyuwela oyamla Tubukona Navau Pakala. E Yonatani saina ininigagi Debida paila uula Saulo eibigigagi matauna.
Eiyam kaukwau Yonatani ila osaivau bibodi Debida makawala si biga bogwa eikakikitasi kasitaiyu. E Yonatani ivakouli taitala gwadi kasitaiyu
e iluki matauna kawala, “Ka, kusakaula kula kunevi makaisina kaiyala balavi.” Gwadi magudina isakaula ila, e Yonatani ilavi ikalituwoli matauna.
Avai tuta gwadi magudina isakaila makatupona ambaisa kaiyala makaina eitobu, Yonatani iwakula ilukwaiwa matauna kawala, “Kaitala makaina sitana ewaiwa!
Gala wala bukutotu baisa. Kunanakwa!” E gwadi magudina isau kaiyala makaina imiaki Yonatani.
Mitaga magudina gwadi gala itapuloki nanola avaka uula vavagi makwaisina. Mesinaku wala kasitaiyu Yonatani sola Debida inikolaisi.
Oluvi Yonatani isaiki la kaiyala baisa magudina e iluki bikau bilau ovalu.

Avai tuta gwadi magudina bogwa eisilavi, Debida isunapula metoya kabosipepuni opapala magulona dakuna. Matauna itapopula kwaitutula e sivatolu ikululu migila opwaipwaia. Kasitaiyu ikaipapasi deli ivalamsi. Yonatani nanola saina mmayuyu, mitaga Debida kala mmayuyu nanola saina siligaga.

E Yonatani iluki Debida kawala, “Ibodi Yaubada bisikailim! Guyau bogwa bikabwailidasi kidamwa yoku yeigu, e dalegu dalem, komwaidodasi goli bitauvagaisi makawala makwaina biga katotila kwaibumaboma kadataiyu bogwa leitakatotila, tuta gala biwokuva goli.” E oluvi Debida isilavi, e Yonatani ikeiita ila ovalu.

footnotes.text: Navau Tubukona Pakala.Kugisi makasana Biga Kala Katumiki. Wa paka makwaina ibodi komwaidona bwala kala tosisu bisuvisi bipakasi.
